display.purpose: Home hero headline only, capped at 14ch, two-tone with Muted Ink em-span.

body.purpose: All running text, constrained to ~65-75ch in the 760px narrow container.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows, section labels, marquee heading. 0.15em tracking, tabular numerals on indices.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow on the profile/preview card only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Framed imagery (portrait, case cover) lifted off the wall.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Lightbox image over a dimmed backdrop. The only deep shadow in the system.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Continuous seamless tools-marquee scroll, no hover-pause.

components.name: Contact Pill Button
components.description: Outlined pill that inverts to solid Ink on hover. Used for contact and CTA links.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--fg, #0a0a0a); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); background: transparent; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-pill:hover { background: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); color: var(--bg, #fff); } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outcome Card
components.description: Square-cornered, flat, border-only stat card. Big Ink stat over Muted Ink description.
components.html:
90%
Grade on the final cut, with positive feedback on narrative structure and production quality.
components.css: .ds-outcome-card { border: 1px solid var(--line, #e5e5e5); padding: 2rem; background: var(--bg, #fff); } .ds-stat { font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); } .ds-desc { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--fg-muted, #6b6b6b); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Circular icon button, Muted Ink at rest, Hover Wash background and Ink icon on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle theme"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--fg-muted, #6b6b6b); background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); background: var(--hover, #f5f5f5); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fg, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Muted Ink text link, shifts to Ink on hover. No underline, no pill, no active color.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2.5rem; padding: 1.25rem 0; } .ds-nav-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--fg-muted, #6b6b6b); letter-spacing: -0.005em; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); }

components.name: Pull Quote
components.description: Editorial blockquote with the system's only intentional 2px left border. Scoped to long-form prose.
components.html:
Your decision to focus on the founders' journey strengthens the emotional appeal.

Professor Luke Russell, CCT453
components.css: .ds-pullquote { border-left: 2px solid var(--fg, #0a0a0a); padding-left: 2rem; margin: 2.5rem 0; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); } .ds-pullquote cite { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--fg-muted, #6b6b6b); font-weight: 400; margin-top: 1rem; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Uppercase micro-label with wide tracking. Marks sections and eyebrows.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--fg-muted, #6b6b6b); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: The work hangs on a neutral wall. The site is the frame, not the painting. Every choice recedes so the case studies hold the visitor's eye; whitespace is the matting, monochrome is the gallery's refusal to compete with the art. The system is achromatic by doctrine: no brand color, no accent hue, no gradient. Contrast does the work color usually does. Type is a single family, Inter, worked hard across weight and scale. Motion is minimal and exponential, present only to confirm a state change. It rejects template-portfolio shells, Dribbble-bait over-design, corporate-SaaS cliche, and dev-bro neon; the dark default reads quiet and editorial, never hacker terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic: contrast carries meaning, not hue.
Single typeface (Inter), wide weight and scale range.
Generous, varied whitespace as the primary compositional tool.
Hairline borders (1px) structure the page; flat at rest.
Dark by default, light by toggle, both equally considered.

rules.name: The No-Hue Rule
rules.body: This portfolio has no brand color and never will. If a screen needs emphasis, it comes from weight, scale, or the Ink-on-Paper inversion, never from introducing a hue.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Emphasis at maximum strength is a full Ink/Paper swap (pill button hover, text selection), not a tint. The flip is the loudest move the system permits.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter carries the entire system. Adding a second typeface is prohibited; the answer to 'needs more personality' is more weight or scale, not more fonts.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Headline Rule
rules.body: Hero emphasis uses Muted Ink on part of the headline, never italics, never color.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, list rows, and containers carry zero shadow until the user touches them. If a surface has an ambient shadow with no interaction behind it, remove it; let the Hairline border define the edge.

dos: Do carry the entire palette as Ink-on-Paper plus four neutrals. Emphasis is weight, scale, or the full Ink/Paper inversion.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; introduce shadow only on hover, float, or overlay.
Do use 1px Hairline borders and the Paper/Riser tonal step for structure.
Do push Inter hard across weight (400-600) and scale (0.75rem to 5rem); maintain at least a 1.25 ratio between hierarchy steps.
Do set uppercase micro-labels at 0.15em tracking and use tabular numerals for indices and stats.
Do constrain running text to the 760px narrow container so body measure stays 65-75ch.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on the marquee and all transitions (WCAG AA).
donts: Don't introduce any brand color, accent hue, or gradient. The No-Hue Rule is absolute.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient text, glassmorphism as decoration, or the hero-metric template.
Don't build identical icon-heading-text card grids, the corporate-SaaS cliche.
Don't let the dark default drift toward dev-bro neon: no terminal green, no neon accents.
Don't add a colored border-left stripe to cards or callouts. The one 2px left border is the editorial pull-quote.
Don't nest cards, and don't wrap content in a container that does not need one.
Don't ship a template-portfolio or Dribbble-bait look.
